item.title: Luan 0.1.0 (Build 19)
item.description:
• The Integrations page shows the Claude Code and Codex CLI brand icons, and About in the Settings sidebar uses an info icon.
  • A shorter menu bar menu: sound preview and the Claude Code and Codex submenus are gone. Install and remove integrations from the Integrations page in Settings.
  • When an integration needs repair, the menu bar menu shows a reminder that opens the Integrations page in Settings.
  • The menu item "Settings & Install…" is now just "Settings…".
  • Free users can now see and click the sound source actions on the Sounds page. Clicking one explains that sound sources are a Pro feature and offers a button that goes straight to the License page.

Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26 or later. Ad-hoc signed and not notarized by Apple. Test license activation is still simulated and does not represent a purchase.
